The '''Malvina clan''', also known as '''Clan Malvina''', was a [[Nyriaanan]] clan that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==History==
During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Yrssk]] became an associate of a number of members of the Malvina clan. A group of Republic agents on Nyriaan attempted to find Yrssk whilst they investigated the [[Deluge Experiment]], so the Trandoshan attempted deceive the Malvina clan into attacking the agents. The clan had a dislike for miners, which Yrssk capitalized on by telling the clan's leaders that the agents were miners scouting out a new location for a mine. The clan leaders were not convinced by his claim, and they dispatched several small scout groups to check whether any incursions were being made onto the clan's land.
